messages:
sarah_marketing: Quick sync — final pass on the pricing page experiment before we flip the switch tomorrow. Need agreement on: FAQ wording, tier names, calculator microcopy, webinar CTA routing, and benchmark narrative for the launch post. See doc: https://docs.google.com/drive/placeholder

david_growth: Oof timing but got it. I can own the launch post narrative + metrics we call out. tentative KPI: signups from pricing funnel, time-to-first-request, and demo requests routed.

elaine_product: I'll finalize the FAQ edits. Couple edge Qs I flagged: data residency for Dedicated, and how caching affects token cost. Short answers preferred.

jamie_design: Calculator UX: I pushed a small tweak — show 'estimated monthly spend' and a tooltip for batch size. Can we approve copy?

jamie_design: Copy suggestion for tooltip: `Estimated monthly spend is based on your avg tokens/day, batch config, and model profile. This is an estimate — final invoice may vary.`

raj_sales: For webinar routing: please set CTA on pricing page to route enterprise leads to the webinar sign-up if they choose 'Dedicated' or 'Private' tiers. Everything else goes to normal trial flow. Can we use `?lead_source=pricing_webinar` query param?

pricebot: reminder: scheduled snapshot tests ran at 1714999000 — no regressions on calculator math.

sarah_marketing: Nice. David — can you draft the benchmark narrative with a 1-paragraph blurb + 3 metric bullets? Make it concrete: latency, cost savings vs baseline, and concurrency.

david_growth: Yep. Draft incoming in ~45min. Will use numbers from the optimize-run doc: 20–35% cost reduction on common conversational profile, median p95 latency 120ms, tested 100 concurrent streams. Link: https://drive/optimize-run-placeholder

elaine_product: FAQ snippets — two short Q/As:
```
Q: How do tier names map to capacity?
A: Starter = hosted shared, Growth = hosted with higher quotas, Dedicated = reserved GPU pools, Private = VPC/on-prem. Contact sales for custom SLOs.
\nQ: Will quantized models reduce quality?
A: We recommend quantization profiles validated per model. Optimize will flag regressions; see the quality notes in model card.
```

jamie_design: CTA microcopy options for pricing hero:
- "Start free trial" (default)
- "Join pricing webinar" (enterprise path)
- "Estimate your costs" (opens calculator modal)
Which two should we surface on desktop?

sarah_marketing: Desktop: 1) Start free trial, 2) Estimate your costs. Webinar CTA only appears in the Dedicated/Private tier cards and as a secondary link for enterprise.

raj_sales: Ok routing plan confirmed. When people click "Join pricing webinar" set path to `/webinar?utm=pricing_page&tier=dedicated` and fire lead tag `pricing_webinar`. We'll pick them up in Marketo.

david_growth: Draft of launch post blurb: "Redwood Inference introduces a simplified pricing experience with an interactive cost estimator and clearer tier names — helping engineers choose the right tradeoffs between latency, cost, and isolation. Benchmarks show up to 35% cost reduction in conversational workloads with optimized settings."

sarah_marketing: Nice start. Add a callout sentence about rollback plan and canary: "We will canary the change for 10% of traffic, monitor signup conversion and calculator errors, and rollback if сайт errors > 0.5% or conversion drops > 10%."

purpose_note: (internal) Action items: Elaine — finalize FAQ by EOD; Jamie — lock calculator tooltip + desktop CTAs; David — post draft + metrics; Raj — confirm lead routing payload; Sarah — schedule canary and email comms for tomorrow AM.

sarah_marketing: Thanks team. I'll update the doc and tag stakeholders. Ping here if anything blocks. :rocket:
